items.html: *And now we shall explain these three heads, which the Idra calls the aspect of two discernments, only two heads, as above. We explained above that each of these three heads, whose totality is only two heads, has in it essence and vessels, and they are six discernments; and each discernment includes three; thus they are all eighteen discernments, as above, of which the RDL"A is not included in their totality at all.
